messages:
jamal: Pushed delta-installer v2.7.1-rc1 to staging mirrors and kicked off a limited canary to 4 private VPC customers. Running mirror-sync and preflight checks now. Noting a couple of RHEL8 hosts failed preflight in the first wave. @ops-release FYI.

deploy-bot: Canary report (wave 1):
```
canary_id: c-2026-03-delta-01
targets: 4 customers (10 nodes)
success: 7/10
failures: 3
failed_checks: preflight (selinux policy), image-checksum-mismatch on customer-mirror
logs: https://internal.ci/canaries/c-2026-03-delta-01
```

sara: which nodes are failing? need the exact checksum mismatch and the artifact path.

deploy-bot: failures:
- cust-a-node3: /mirrors/cust-a/v2.7.1-rc1/installer.tar.gz (expected sha256: ab12...ef, got: ab12...00)
- cust-b-node1: preflight selinux flagged (auditd)
- cust-c-node2: image-checksum mismatch for runtime-image: sha256 77aa... != 77aa...ff

maria: ugh. If the checksum mismatch is at the mirror level we should pause. Could be a republish truncated object or an S3 eventual consistency race. I recommend pausing the canary and pinning the release pointer back to v2.7.0 to avoid exposing more customers.

jamal: Agree. Pause canary now. We'll treat this as a rollout-abort and do an immediate rollback plan: 1) stop further waves 2) pin live pointer -> v2.7.0 3) re-run mirror-verify against origin artifacts 4) rebuild signed manifest if needed. @ops-release can you confirm mirror status?

ops-release: Pausing waves now (abort flag set). Initiated mirror-republish from origin bucket to internal cache for the /v2.7.1-rc1 prefix. Starting checksum-verify job across edge caches. ETA ~12m. Will post updates. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kevin: quick helper: run `./tools/mirror-verify --prefix v2.7.1-rc1 --origin s3://release-origin --fix-missing` on the cache host; that will surface truncated objects. I ran it on one edge and it found a 0-byte object that matched the symptoms.

maria: If we republish and checksums match origin, we can attempt a fresh canary with a rebuilt cosign-signed manifest. If not, we ship a hotfix patch (v2.7.1-rc1 -> v2.7.1-patch1) and keep pointer pinned to stable.

jamal: Decision: abort current canary, pin live pointer to v2.7.0 (prod pointer set), block any automatic rollouts for this release id. ops-release to republish and verify. eng-release (maria) will draft a release note blurb describing the checksum regression and remediation steps for customers. We'll create a short KB for customers with custom mirror setups explaining how to run mirror-verify and re-sync.

maria: I'll open PR to release-notes repo and docs with the blurb and KB. Draft snippet: "Canary for v2.7.1-rc1 was paused due to checksum mismatch observed on some customer mirrors; rollout aborted and production pointer pinned to v2.7.0. We are republishing artifacts and will either reattempt canary or publish a patched artifact. If you host a private mirror, run mirror-verify and contact support if you see mismatches."

deploy-bot: Rollback actions executed:
```
- canary c-2026-03-delta-01: stopped
- prod-pointer: set -> v2.7.0
- auto-rollout[release=2.7.1-rc1]: disabled
- mirror-verify jobs: started (job id mv-8831)
```

jamal: Thanks everyone. Action items: ops-release (republish + confirm checksums mv-8831), kevin (help inspect any truncated objects), maria (PR for release-notes + KB), sara (coordinate with SE for affected customers and post customer-facing message once we have confirmation). I'll own the postmortem and root-cause tracking. :thumbsup:

ops-release: mirror-verify mv-8831 reported 2 truncated objects; republish fixed them. Verified checksums now match origin. Recommend we hold off on reattempt until we have a signed manifest rebuild.

maria: I'll start the cosign manifest rebuild and sign pipeline. Will tag new artifact v2.7.1-patch1 if any binary rebuilds are necessary.

kevin: I pushed a small helper script to speed up mirror rehydration: https://internal.tools/mirror-fix, use with caution.

jamal: Closing thread; will reopen if reattempt scheduled. Thanks all.
